name: Lake Mega Chad

goals.description: Little Gas Stop - Refuel and fill gas cans.
Police Department - Access the vault and get guns and ammo. Use sledgehammer to access from outside.
Bouquets by Tinka - Look for Garden Forks and Literature

memorableMoments: First day, I come across a mint Fire Department D6 with a sledgehammer in the back.
Hunting for a generator, I ran out of gas. Spent all night to get back to camp.
Set up a base in the leather factory at the edge of Rosewood. Comfortable, but in no way assured for success
